args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting the FIN-212 requirement (and its own docstring) for banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
